description: This file contains platform-specific setup and upgrade functions for embedded devices running OpenWrt, including device initialization, upgrading procedures, and image validation.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI partitions on ASUS devices when running on initramfs.

methods.name: buffalo_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes MTD partitions for Buffalo devices.

methods.name: xiaomi_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI partitions and sets environment variables on Xiaomi devices running on initramfs.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates firmware images for different device types before flashing.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to device-specific locations during setup.
